title: Kostas Kneels
prompt:
Kostas kneels in wet stone and low fog, furious and afraid, looking up from below. The Flame Emperor stands above him in the red horned mask and black-red cloak, calm and dominant. Torchlight flickers against ruins and armor. The power relationship is clear: Kostas is disposable, the masked figure is in control.

Camera: low-angle slow push from Kostas toward the Flame Emperor silhouette.
